# ECN-2026-007 - Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

Reason for change
This ECN updates the main ram bolt torque specification for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 to address observed bolt preload loss during routine maintenance and to reduce risk of ram misalignment. Field inspections and retention of fastener condition require standardization of the torque value to ensure consistent clamp load and to improve joint integrity under cyclic operational loading. This change responds to findings in related maintenance and safety bulletins and aligns shop practice with current maintenance guidance.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02 (main ram bolt)  
- Maintenance procedures: SOP-P1-L4-05 (inspection and bolting steps)  
- Maintenance work package: MM-P1-L4-HP02  
- Safety bulletin: SB-1034 (referenced for hazard controls)

Implementation
- Update the main ram bolt torque for EQ-P1-L4-HP02: the main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 970 N·m.  
- Revise SOP-P1-L4-05 to reflect the new torque value and include verification acceptance criteria during post-torque inspection.  
- Update MM-P1-L4-HP02 work instructions and checklist items to require torque confirmation and recordkeeping per existing document control requirements.  
- Execute a one-time re-torque and inspection of EQ-P1-L4-HP02 during the next planned maintenance window; record results in the maintenance log and close out per SOP-P1-L4-05.  
- Ensure personnel performing the work are briefed on SB-1034 for required PPE and lockout procedures before starting work.

Approvals
Prepared by: Maintenance Engineering (refer to MM-P1-L4-HP02)  
Reviewed by: Plant Mechanical Lead (see SOP-P1-L4-05)  
Approved by: Plant Manager (reference SB-1034 for safety concurrence)

Related documents: MM-P1-L4-HP02, SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-05
